parameters.description: Case-insensitive key name search: optional surrounding Unicode whitespace (the handler trims with str::trim), then at most 200 non-control characters (KeyListQuery::bounds, keys.rs:85-90: the trimmed value is counted in characters and refused if any is a control character); a blank value means no filter. There is no maxLength because it would count the padding. The pattern's \s equals Rust's trim except U+FEFF (ECMA-262 whitespace, not trimmed by Rust) and U+0085 (trimmed by Rust, not ECMA \s), and an engine without the Unicode flag counts a character above U+FFFF as two units in the 200 bound.
